children.text: /* @component: more-text */ (function () { function initRew() { const rewSlides = [...document.querySelectorAll('.more-text')]; rewSlides.forEach((container) => { const btn = container.querySelector('a.more-text-link, .more-text_link'); if (!btn) return; const span = btn.querySelector('.more-text-span, span'); const text = container.querySelector('.more-text-p'); const svg = btn.querySelector('.more-text-svg, .more-text_svg'); if (!span || !text) return; text.style.overflow = 'hidden'; let isAnimating = false; btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (isAnimating) return; isAnimating = true; const isActive = text.classList.toggle('_is-active'); if (svg) svg.style.transform = isActive ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)'; const collapsedHeight = '4.5em'; const fullHeight = text.scrollHeight + 'px'; const heightAnim = text.animate([{ maxHeight: isActive ? collapsedHeight : fullHeight }, { maxHeight: isActive ? fullHeight : collapsedHeight }], { duration: 250, easing: 'ease', fill: 'forwards' }); const anim = span.animate([{ opacity: '1' }, { opacity: '0' }], { duration: 125, easing: 'ease', fill: 'forwards' }); anim.addEventListener('finish', () => { span.textContent = isActive ? 'Скрыть' : 'Читать далее'; span.animate([{ opacity: '0' }, { opacity: '1' }], { duration: 125, easing: 'ease', fill: 'forwards' }); }); heightAnim.addEventListener('finish', () => { isAnimating = false; }); }); }); } if (document.readyState === 'loading') { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initRew); } else { initRew(); } })(); /* @end: more-text */
